inputs.text: Wake up and look at the real agenda behind what they are feeding us. Taoiseach Micheál Martin came out in Limerick this past week to push the official line, claiming that housing tenancies have increased. It is all part of a carefully coordinated script to distract from the obvious manipulation. They want you to ignore the glaring reality that there is concern regarding an increase in eviction notices and homelessness following the new rules introduced by the Government on March 1, which require landlords to provide tenants with six-year leases. Do not fall for their inversion of the truth. Look at what is actually happening behind closed doors: the number of people in emergency accommodation across the country has risen once more, according to the Limerick Post. This is precisely what the hidden elites and institutions planned all along.

subtopics: Micheál Martin's claim that housing tenancies increased
